Harappan Structures.txt.author: ASHISH
Harappan Structures.txt.content: The massive Harappan-inspired pillars stands before you. After years of preparation, coaching classes, exams and counselling rounds, you are finally an IIT Ropar student.

Security Paaji.txt.author: ASHISH
Security Paaji.txt.content: Kaise ho bachche? Registration complete karwa lo pehle. And Welcome maje karo ab!

Campus Map.txt.author: ASHISH
Campus Map.txt.content: You stare at the campus map. Everything looks important and everything looks far away. You notice empty spaces in the map and come to know IIT Ropar is still in it's first stage of development...Anyways, The Admin Block seems to be somewhere ahead.

Parents Goodbye.txt.author: ASHISH
Parents Goodbye.txt.content:
You watch several parents giving final instructions. 'Beta khana time pe khana.' 
'Beta phone karna.' 
'Beta padhai pe dhyan dena.'

audi.txt.author: ASHISH
audi.txt.content: The foyer is packed with nervous freshers carrying files and folders. Some look confident. Most are excited.

Orientation Schedule.txt.author: ASHISH
Orientation Schedule.txt.content:
09:00 Welcome Session
10:00 Director Address
11:00 Institute Overview
12:00 Questions From Freshers
12:01 More Questions From Freshers and meet with General Secretaries

Sleepy Fresher.txt.author: ASHISH
Sleepy Fresher.txt.content: A student sitting in the corner is already asleep. Orientation has only been running for twenty minutes. Must be tired from travelling from Chandigarh...

Senior Volunteer.txt.author: ASHISH
Senior Volunteer.txt.content: Don't worry. Everyone gets lost during the first week. Some people continue getting lost during the fourth year as well xD

desk.txt.author: ASHISH
desk.txt.content: Registration completed? Good. Now get your biometrics done in the Admin Block.

Volunteer 2.txt.author: ASHISH
Volunteer 2.txt.content: You're looking for biometrics? Admin Block East Wing. And no, I don't know where your hostel is.

Document Checklist.txt.author: ASHISH
Document Checklist.txt.content:
Required Documents:

✓ Admission Letter
✓ ID Proof
✓ Photographs
✓ Patience

Missing_Pen.txt.author: ASHISH
Missing_Pen.txt.content: The pen is chained to the table. SON...

Photo Spot.txt.author: ASHISH
Photo Spot.txt.content:
A group of freshers is already taking photos.

Your Achievement Progress:
0/500 LOC Photos LOL

Influencer.txt.author: ASHISH
Influencer.txt.content: This student has been on campus for five minutes and has already uploaded three Instagram stories.

Selfie Group.txt.author: ASHISH
Selfie Group.txt.content: Three freshers are taking group photos as if graduation is tomorrow.

Directions.txt.author: ASHISH
Directions.txt.content:
East Wing -> Registrars
West Wing -> Administrative Offices
Wrong Turn -> Director Office

Lost Student.txt.author: ASHISH
Lost Student.txt.content: I came here looking for the UG Registrar. Somehow I reached the Director Office.

registrar.txt.author: ASHISH
registrar.txt.content: You have completed your academic registration. One final step remains: biometrics.

Queue.txt.author: ASHISH
Queue.txt.content:
Current Queue Length: 17

Estimated Wait Time: Forever.

Helpful Clue.txt.author: ASHISH
Helpful Clue.txt.content: LOC ka full form LOC ko khud bhi nahi pata.

Fingerprint Scanner.txt.author: ASHISH
Fingerprint Scanner.txt.content: The scanner rejects your finger once. Then twice. Finally it accepts that you exist.

Admin Staff.txt.author: ASHISH
Admin Staff.txt.content: Congratulations. You can now enter through biometric gates instead of signing the register every time.

scanner.txt.author: ASHISH
scanner.txt.content:
Biometrics completed successfully.

Activation Code: IITRPR2026

Pass this code as an argument to the ENTER DECRYPTION KEY box to proceed to Level 2.

Awadh.txt.author: ASHISH
Awadh.txt.content: Several administrative offices are located here. Everyone seems busy.

Annam.txt.author: ASHISH
Annam.txt.content: A staff member asks if you need help. You panic and say 'No' despite being completely lost.

notice.txt.author: ASHISH
notice.txt.content: Notice: Students entering without purpose will be stared at intensely.

Receptionist.txt.author: ASHISH
Receptionist.txt.content: The receptionist looks at you. You look at the receptionist. Both of you know you are not supposed to be here.

Meeting In Progress.txt.author: ASHISH
Meeting In Progress.txt.content: A meeting is currently in progress. Your chances of finding useful information here are roughly equal to attending every 8 AM class this semester.

homesick.txt.author: ASHISH
homesick.txt.content: The room feels quieter than home. Maybe that's because your roommate hasn't arrived yet.

future_memory.txt.author: ASHISH
future_memory.txt.content: One day you'll walk through this campus without needing a map.

README.txt.author: ASHISH
README.txt.content:
LEVEL 1: KNOW YOUR CAMPUS


You have finally arrived at IIT Ropar.

Your parents have left. Your hostel room is ready. Your new life is about to begin.

Unfortunately, your admission process is not complete yet.

Tasks:
1. Visit the Auditorium Foyer.
2. Complete registration.
3. Find the Admin Block.
4. Locate the UG Registrar.
5. Complete your biometrics.
6. Discover the activation code.

Enter the code in the ENTER DESCRIPTION KEY HERE box and proceed to next level.
